title: scorzoneroides microcephala
intro: Scorzoneroides microcephala, commonly known as Bristle-bell or Bristle bellflower, is a perennial plant species in the family Compositae. It is valued for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The plant is said to have anti-inflammatory, analgesic, and antipyretic properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions. The bioactive constituents of Scorzoneroides microcephala include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which are believed to be responsible for its health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
